title: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
issues: Fails to start with "Cannot find 800x600x32 video mode" unless Wine's virtual desktop is enabled (HKCU\Software\Wine\Explorer Desktop=Default, size matching the in-game resolution). No native fullscreen inside the virtual desktop window. DXVK is extremely slow (menus and gameplay); wined3d runs well. DualSense needed Enable SDL + DisableHidraw in winebus.

title: gta-sa
notes: Went through the intro cutscene of GTA san andreas, rode the bike at the start of the game around for about 5 minutes. Game ran perfectly at a smooth 60FPS with very minor stuttering that did not affect gameplay.
issues: Fails to launch (Cannot find 800x600x32 video mode). Game launches just fine after installing a few community fixes. Plays perfectly
